summary: Recorded the owner's blanket approval of the runtime creative set and cleared the deployment gate. RIGHTS-AND-IMAGE2-APPROVAL-20260729-001 captures the basis (owner instruction in-session, artifacts reviewed via contact sheets and rendered screens), approves 44 assets across six lots (card faces, transparent duty gods v003, header bands, pair portraits, game key arts, the Zipangu backdrop), marks the seven opaque duty paintings superseded by their transparent v003 replacements, and records the 28 swarm sprites as explicitly rejected and excluded — they stay disabled behind SWARM_ENABLED=false until the style spike verdict produces a replacement lot. blockers.description: A separate owner-run session implements Discord login inside the OTOMO CHAIN 7 repository; its server side is committed and deployed with the feature disabled while its web side was still uncommitted. Writing there from this session would destroy concurrent work, and that session's git housekeeping has already deleted an untracked directory created here, so generated assets are produced outside the repository until they are committed.
blockers.resolution_required: Confirm the OTOMO CHAIN work is committed and its export shape final before this session adapts dashboard reconciliation or edits that repository.

blockers.description: OTOMO CHAIN 7 exposes external_id only through its admin-secret reward-export endpoint. The reconciliation and payout code is deployed but remains disabled until OTOMO_CHAIN_EXPORT_URL and OTOMO_CHAIN_ADMIN_SECRET are configured after season end.

blockers.description: Stable Next and Miniflare still require Sharp 0.34.5, which npm audit flags for inherited libvips advisories. The built Worker has no Sharp or libvips import and the application has no untrusted image-processing path, so the documented owner-only non-reachable exception remains in force.
blockers.resolution_required: Upgrade when stable Next and Cloudflare or Miniflare officially support patched Sharp; reassess immediately if image upload or server-side untrusted processing is added.
